reasons.plausibility: It offers a coherent explanation involving known transformation mechanisms and the possible role of magnetic interactions, though precise quantification of those magnetic effects remains to be validated.
reasons.testability: Systematically varying Mn content and directly measuring the phase transformations, twin densities, and mechanical behavior under well-defined conditions would allow a clear confirmation or refutation of the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a clear mechanistic pathway to guide alloy design and performance optimization by targeting compositional and structural control, addressing a critical question in high-entropy alloy research.
